payload.text: fgOS has no npm runtime dependency; YAML is read through one vendored parser (js-yaml 5.4.3) behind src/util/yaml.mjs
payload.rationale: A checkout or worktree without npm install could not load modules importing yaml, and doctor/setup grew hand-written YAML readers to cope; one vendored, hash-pinned parser removes the cause. Narrative and evidence: docs/specs/distribution.md decision history 2026-10-16.
